title: 🚩 How to Spot Red Flags in a Guy. Part 4
body: He is never wrong. Not once. Every argument ends when you say sorry. He is rude to the waiter, the driver and the Wi-Fi guy, and calls it "being direct." Ask how he treats people who cannot do anything for him. That is his real personality. The rest is a performance for you.
caption:
Save this before your next situationship.

title: 🚩 How to Spot Red Flags in a Girl. Part 4
body: She says she is over her ex but knows his coffee order, his new car and his new girlfriend's university. "We're just friends" and he comments a fire emoji on every photo. "He means nothing to me" for forty minutes. Then she checks if he watched her story. He did.
caption:
Which one is you? Be honest.

title: 🚩 Red Flags in a Rishta Meeting. Part 4
body: His mother says "he's very shy." He is thirty two and a cardiologist. He answers every question with "ji." His father talks about a plot for twenty minutes. His sister inspects your sandals. His brother stays on the phone. Nobody asks you a single real question.
caption:
Save this for the next aunty visit.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 The Maybe Zone. Part 4
body: She wished you happy birthday at 11:58pm with "hbd." You wrote her a paragraph last month. In the maybe zone, effort goes one way and the reply has no punctuation. If the bare minimum feels like a gift, you have been starving for a while.
caption:
Send this to someone who needs a clear no.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 Red Flags on a First Date. Part 4
body: He takes twelve photos of the food and zero of you. He asks you to post it and tag him. His story says "good vibes only" and you were not the vibe. Rule: if the food gets more attention than you, order dessert for yourself and let the food have him.
caption:
Tag your date's group chat.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 Red Flags When He Texts. Part 4
body: "Typing..." for eight minutes, then "okay." He wrote a poem, deleted the poem, and sent "okay." Online at 3:12, last seen 3:13, no reply. Worse, he likes your friend's story in the same minute. Not busy. Just not interested enough to type.
caption:
Send this to the one who reads and does not reply.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 Her Emotional Support Contact. Part 4
body: You remember her exam dates, her mother's surgery and her cousin's name. She forgets your job. "What do you do again?" for the third time. You gave her two hours of listening last night. She gave you a "haha true" this morning. The listening is unpaid.
caption:
Tag the friend who needs to stop being the helpline.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 How to Never Date a Playboy. Part 4
body: His friends call you "bhabhi" after one dinner. Or they call you the wrong name and nobody corrects it. A playboy's friends are a witness protection programme. They are extra nice, a little guilty, and always change the topic when his phone rings.
caption:
Screenshot this for your next situationship.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 Red Flags in His Instagram. Part 4
body: His story is a sunset with "some people don't deserve you." Nobody knows who he means. A quote about loyalty at 3am. A sad song with lyrics he does not understand. When you ask, "it's just a song." It is never just a song. It is a subtweet with a playlist.
caption:
Tag the friend who needs an Instagram audit.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 The Taxi Light Theory. Part 4
body: How to tell the taxi is off duty. He talks about next year, always next year. After I settle. After I buy a house. After my sister's wedding. The list gets longer every month. The light is off, the engine is cold, and you are still standing on the road.
caption:
Tag the friend waiting for him to be ready.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 Who Has to Approve Your Marriage. Part 4
body: The Dubai uncle joins by video call at 2am. He has not been in Pakistan for eleven years and has strong opinions on your choices. He votes no because "the culture has changed." He is the only one who changed. His vote still counts. His call quality does not.
caption:
Tag the friend whose uncle has opinions.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 How to Find a Spiritual Partner. Part 4
body: He says "I'm picking up a weird energy from you" when you ask a simple question. "I can't talk, Mercury is in retrograde." It has been in retrograde since March, for him. He can see your aura but not the restaurant bill. The universe always seems to send him the cheque.
caption:
Tag the friend who dated a life coach.

title: 🚩 How to Read a Rishta Profile. Part 4
body: "Simple family." The wedding has eight hundred guests, four cars and a stage with a throne. Simple is the word they use before they show you the budget. The family is simple. The expectations are a luxury edition with a sunroof. And a gift receipt for later.
caption:
Send this to the matchmaker aunty.
